integrity: The nonasymptotic geometry and finite-threshold quadrature are checked by included reproducible code; the infinite asymptotic claim relies on its written proof rather than numerical evidence.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to three independent uniform circle tangents conditioned on enclosing the unit disk.
The theorem is an upper-tail expansion, not an all-threshold closed-form perimeter density.
A directly relevant 2015 primary paper could be assessed only from its accessible abstract; earlier priority is therefore provisional.
Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: A sharp logarithmic second correction for random tangent-triangle area tails
